description:
## [1.7.2](https://github.com/Piracola/Pixiv-Patched/compare/v1.7.1...v1.7.2) (2026-11-12)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **ui:** draw the settings groups as rounded cards ([f5ce60c](https://github.com/Piracola/Pixiv-Patched/commit/f5ce60c9266090eb61dde54ae07181ae313ae730))

patches.name: Pixiv AI Work Flagger
patches.description: Identifies AI-generated works from Pixiv's illustAiType field, dims their thumbnails with an [AI] badge or hides them, adds a warning banner and an [AI] title pill on the detail screen, and can auto-block AI artists or drop works whose tags match a blacklist. Adjustable in the Pixiv-Patched page.

patches.name: Pixiv Adblocker
patches.description: Removes the bottom banner frame on every screen, blocks AppLovin interstitials, suppresses rate-this-app dialogs, and hides sponsored works in feeds and on the illustration detail screen.

patches.name: Pixiv Bookmark Threshold
patches.description: Drops works below the chosen bookmark count from search results on the device, for illusts and novels alike, and tops a short page up from the following pages so it does not turn blank. The request itself is left alone, so the floor works with search words in any language. Adjustable in the Pixiv-Patched page.

patches.name: Pixiv Browsing History
patches.description: Records the illustrations, manga and novels opened in the app into a history kept on the device, and takes over Pixiv's history screen with it (manga and novels on separate tabs).

patches.name: Pixiv Downloader
patches.description: Adds a save button to the illustration and manga detail screen that writes the original artwork to Pictures/Pixiv, named after the work id, title and author. Android 9 and older save into the app's private folder.

patches.name: Pixiv Enhanced Viewer & Instant Zoom
patches.description: Shows the standard-resolution artwork as an instant placeholder while the full-resolution image loads, so pinch-to-zoom and panning work right away and keep their position when the full image replaces the placeholder.

patches.name: Pixiv Novel Text Copy
patches.description: Re-enables text handling on the novel reader: long-press selection in the body, caption and series description, and a reader menu with copy title, copy author and download-full-text (title, caption, link and body saved as a .txt in Downloads).

patches.name: Pixiv OLED Dark Theme
patches.description: Overrides the dark theme's surface and background colours with pure black (#ff000000).

patches.name: Pixiv Popular Search Trial
patches.description: Pins the 7-day popular-search trial countdown so a trial account keeps getting the trial version of the popular tab instead of falling back to the preview/paywall. Does not change what Pixiv returns for accounts without the trial.

patches.name: Pixiv Popular Search Unlock
patches.description: Fakes the premium flag in the search pager so the app asks for popular_desc. Pixiv still answers a free account with date order.

patches.name: Pixiv Premium Features
patches.description: Emulates client-side Pixiv Premium membership status and removes the mute list limits.

patches.name: Pixiv Search Ranking
patches.description: Fills the Popular search tab on a free account with Pixiv's free popularity preview (about 30 illusts or novels), for both illust and novel search. Adjustable in the Pixiv-Patched page.

patches.name: Pixiv-Patched Drawer Entry
patches.description: Adds a Pixiv-Patched item to Pixiv's home drawer. The page it opens holds the AI work display settings, the popular-search ranking and the bookmark threshold, shows the state of the other patches, and lists the browsing history kept on this device.
